map.增强后总量 = 原始样本数 × (1 + 系数 × 变换种类数): Augmented total = original samples × (1 + coefficient × number of transform types)
map.按每种变换贡献的增量线性外推总量，系数反映单次变换的等效增益（通常 <1）。这是: Linearly extrapolate the total from each transform’s incremental contribution; the coefficient reflects the effective gain per transform (usually < 1). This is an upper bound: when transforms are highly correlated the real effective amount is far smaller, and augmented samples cannot fully replace the distribution coverage of real data.
map.实际去重后可能低于估算。: After deduplication the real amount may be lower than the estimate.
map.×重复系数，用于训练集扩容规划。: × repetition coefficient, for training-set expansion planning.

map.应结合验证集表现设定增强强度，避免过度失真。: Set augmentation strength against validation performance to avoid excessive distortion.

map.数据增强总量（主式）：增强后总量 = 原始样本数 × (1 + 每种倍数 × 变: Total data augmentation (main formula): augmented total = original samples × (1 + multiplier per transform × number of transform types) (samples, shown rounded); e.g. original 1000, multiplier 2, 3 transforms → 1000×(1+6) = 7000. Validation: no strict checks; empty or invalid inputs count as 0. Grading: no fixed tiers; if any term is 0 the result degrades to the original sample count or 0.
map.增强倍数判读（同式换口径）：扩增倍率 = 增强后总量 ÷ 原始样本数 = 1 +: Augmentation-multiplier interpretation (same formula, other basis): expansion ratio = augmented total ÷ original samples = 1 + multiplier × transform types; each extra transform raises the ratio by one "multiplier" step; new samples = total − original, which helps estimate training time and labeling cost. Validation: same as the main formula; with a multiplier or transform count of 0 the ratio degrades to 1 (no gain). Grading: no fixed tiers; only a ratio >1 yields expansion gain.
